purpose: GPU quadratic/cubic FRI with arities 2–16 and nonconstant final polynomials
result: Thirty-six GPU FRI component proofs CPU-verified after shutdown, matching upstream proof bytes with independently checked replayed PoW witnesses; candidate wallet and recursive regressions preserved

general_fri.protocol: Pinned quadratic u^2=7 and existing cubic basis; no protocol parameters or proof encodings changed.
general_fri.pow_comparison: The CPU reference checks and replays each GPU PoW witness. Upstream parallel grinding may select a different valid nonce; byte equality is conditioned on the same independently checked witnesses.
general_fri.scope: GPU FRI operation from uploaded public reduced-input fixtures. CPU-generated input matrix openings are attached outside that operation. This does not establish a complete legacy quadratic STARK/PCS GPU path.

candidate_entrypoints.selection: The complete explicitly initialized owned OpenCL selection routes compatible and GPU-required requests to the owned prover. Other selections retain existing policy admission; strict requests cannot fall back to CPU.
candidate_entrypoints.lifecycle: GPU selection remains configured after engine shutdown. A resident-engine check rejects later requests before the infallible configuration constructor, for both GPU-required and compatible policy, without reinitialization or CPU fallback.
candidate_entrypoints.authorization: The host independently authorizes nonzero in-range mint and issuance count. The request checks the witness amount before private work and rechecks the GPU-produced public mint before proving. No authority is granted by the proof API.
admission_controls: issuance attempted through spend or HTLC route
retired backend under strict or compatible policy
candidate_entrypoints.debug_cpu_audit: Explicit constraint audit remains; trace reads are 622592 bytes for join-split/issuance and 1179648 bytes for HTLC per proof

pilot_notes: Run 01 passed all CPU checks and reached the wallet GPU tests. Rust wallet proofs passed, but the validator rejected missing historical query-prefix transfer telemetry. The driver restores those fields with an extension-aware final-coefficient byte count. Run 01 and its source archive are retained; run 02 qualifies the revised source.

Initial library/test builds exposed a cast parsing issue and missing PrimeField64 imports; the first OpenCL pilot rejected incompatible address-space qualifiers. All failed build/pilot logs are retained.

Pilots 03 and 04 passed arithmetic and produced matching quadratic commitments/final polynomials, but an independently searched CPU PoW witness differed. Upstream parallel grinding may select any valid nonce. The reference now checks and replays GPU witnesses on CPU before byte comparison.

Pilot 05 passed all four constant-polynomial quadratic arities and rejected nonconstant completion because the inverse NTT lacked a Transform receipt. It now uses the existing explicit engine observer.
Pilot 06 acquired no GPU resources because a separate pool workload held the laptop GPU lease. That workload was left running; CPU qualification continued and native testing resumed after release.

Pilot 07 passed arithmetic, both six-scenario FRI proof suites, the existing resident FRI suite and candidate wallet entrypoints. These preliminary cases are not included in final qualification totals.
validator_notes: Every final Rust test count is reparsed from its hashed log. All FRI component reports require exact stage inventories, positive GPU calls/time, zero observation errors and successful strict completion.
CPU-only checks were run first while the laptop GPU was occupied. Resumption verified unchanged source and executable hashes before native checks.
limitations: NVIDIA laptop OpenCL correctness qualification only; no production transaction/hour estimate or resource calibration.

FRI tests start with public CPU reduced-input fixtures and attach CPU input-matrix openings outside the GPU component. Legacy quadratic witness, quotient, opening and whole-STARK/PCS integration remains incomplete.
Debug whole-STARK proofs retain explicit CPU constraint auditing and reject GPU-required requests. Standalone FRI components execute under GPU-required policy in all build profiles.
Nonconstant final polynomials and larger cubic arities are isolated research configurations; pinned legacy and candidate protocol parameters and encodings are unchanged.
Host entropy acquisition, metadata, orchestration, serialization, independent verification and external mint/HTLC acceptance remain host responsibilities.

Private wallet worker transport/admission, batch and C ABI integration, owned multi-AIR commitments, full-size recursive qualification, sustained pool throughput and AMD/Metal qualification remain open. Pending Apple source still requires its authorized local Mac commit.
